items.text: if AI writes all the code, do you still need to learn computer science?
I would think CS degrees are still important. You still need to know how the product works, how the software works.
Imagine I want to make a hill train, right?
It needs engines which are heavy, have big, crazy throttle, crazy torque,
So I can't ask AI to build me a bullet train on Himalayan plateau. I can't.
would customer go and buy it? I don't think so.
So what does a CS degree actually give you?
Well AI know how to build a track, but the question still lies with you.
It knows how to build a train. It doesn't know what you want.
You can only understand what you want by understanding the CS, right? The computer science part, the architecture, the system design,
These questions are answered when you pursue a CS degree.
Would you still pick CS? Tell me in the comments.
